policy.imageRule: No property image renders until a rights-qualified image is tied to a verified matching affiliate referral.
policy.propertyLinkRule: No property deeplink renders until an account-generated affiliate URL is verified. Until then, cards use the approved Expedia search widget.

contexts.proximity: Albert Hotel describes itself as a Hill Country resort in downtown Fredericksburg just off historic Main Street.
contexts.differentiator: A full-service downtown option with restaurants, bars, a pool and spa for travelers who want to stay inside the historic core.

contexts.proximity: The hotel says it sits one block from Main Street in downtown Fredericksburg.
contexts.differentiator: A practical central base with breakfast, parking and outdoor spaces while keeping the shops and restaurants of Main Street close.

contexts.proximity: Hoffman Haus describes its five-acre property as a short walk from Fredericksburg Main Street.
contexts.differentiator: A smaller bed-and-breakfast-style alternative with rooms, suites and private houses rather than a conventional downtown hotel layout.

contexts.proximity: Grand Galvez identifies itself as a historic beachfront Galveston hotel on the Texas Gulf Coast.
contexts.differentiator: A beachfront historic-hotel choice with a spa and resort-style amenities for a Seawall-focused island stay.

contexts.proximity: The Tremont House is in historic downtown Galveston and lists the Port, Pleasure Pier and other island attractions among nearby destinations.
contexts.differentiator: A downtown alternative for travelers pairing the Seawall with The Strand, harbor history and the cruise-port side of the island.

properties.name: Harbor House Hotel & Marina at Pier 21

contexts.proximity: Harbor House says its Pier 21 waterfront location is steps from the cruise terminal and The Strand Historic District.
contexts.differentiator: A harborfront option that works best when a Seawall visit is part of a broader Strand, port or cruise-terminal itinerary.

contexts.proximity: Marriott lists the Texas Ranger Hall of Fame & Museum among the local attractions for Courtyard Waco.
contexts.differentiator: A downtown hotel base for combining the Ranger museum with the convention-center, Brazos River and central-Waco attractions.

contexts.proximity: Hilton places the hotel in downtown Waco on the Brazos River, with Baylor University and several central-Waco attractions nearby.
contexts.differentiator: A riverfront downtown option with free parking and an airport shuttle for a broader Waco museum-and-campus itinerary.

contexts.proximity: Hotel 1928 is at 701 Washington Avenue in downtown Waco and describes Magnolia and Baylor University as close by.
contexts.differentiator: A small historic boutique-hotel option for travelers who want a walkable downtown base rather than a larger conventional hotel.

contexts.proximity: Best Western lists the property at 107 S. U.S. Highway 281 in Johnson City, keeping guests in the town's central visitor area.
contexts.differentiator: A conventional hotel base with complimentary hot breakfast and practical access to downtown Johnson City and Hill Country day trips.

contexts.proximity: Carter Creek lists its resort at 4064 W. U.S. Highway 290 in Johnson City along the Hill Country wine corridor.
contexts.differentiator: A resort-style option combining villas with an on-site winery, restaurant and spa for travelers building a wine-country stay around Johnson City.

contexts.proximity: Walden Retreats places its Johnson City glamping property at 1388 Gipson Road on a 96-acre Hill Country site with Pedernales River access.
contexts.differentiator: A small luxury-glamping alternative with 15 safari-style tents for travelers who prefer an outdoor Hill Country stay over a conventional hotel.
